Pupils from Diosdado Macapagal Elementary School try out the newly opened OASIS Schoolyard on Tuesday, Jan. 13, in Quezon City. 

The OASIS Schoolyards Project, by Resilient Cities Network (R-Cities) and the Temasek Foundation in partnership with the Quezon City government, aims to transform public school grounds into cooler, greener, and more climate-resilient spaces to protect students from extreme heat, flooding, and other climate risks.

📸: Santi San Juan/MB

Members of the Manila Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office conducted a flushing operation after a tanker truck carrying candy syrup spilled along Magsaysay Boulevard on Tuesday, Jan. 13. 

The cleanup was carried out to remove the sticky residue from the roadway, ensuring the safety of motorists and preventing further traffic disruption on the busy thoroughfare. 

📸: Mark Balmores/MB
